long_biography.plain_text:
Nick Candy began renovating flats while working in advertising, after studying human geography at the University of Reading. He and his brother Christian bought their first London flat with help from a £6,000 loan from their grandmother. They lived in it while carrying out improvements, then sold it at a profit.

Further purchases followed while the brothers kept their day jobs. The proceeds from those early deals eventually allowed them to concentrate on property. Their initial specialty was carefully fitted bachelor apartments, followed by increasingly elaborate homes for international buyers.
